scope: AC1018 TABLE direct encoder consistency of retained zero-mask ranges and modeled TABLE override flags
change: The retained four-bit, zero-count TABLE range represents four absent masks. If any source ranges are retained, the direct encoder now also requires a zero modeled TABLE override mask. Existing range-shape, cell, proxy, and graph gates remain separate. Range-empty generated TABLEs can still emit supported overrides.
controls: A generated TABLE is encoded and parsed; its zero-mask ranges are retained in an otherwise encodable model.
Changing the retained TABLE range count to one refuses before modifying seeded body or handle buffers; restoring the original model permits retry.
Selecting a title-row text height of zero against the retained absent-mask range refuses before modifying seeded body or handle buffers; restoring the original model permits retry.
A generated range-empty TABLE with selected zero title-row text height remains encodable.
presenceLimit: The model has no independent hasTableOverrides property. The presence-only control mutates the retained parser range count; it does not claim to generate an independent physical presence-with-zero-mask frame.
